verificationCommands: cd kid-kode-landing && node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const j=JSON.parse(readFileSync('public/prism-mock/home/live-graph.json','utf8')); const home=j.nodes.filter(n=>n.parentHubId==='home'); if(home.length<6){console.error('home nodes='+home.length);process.exit(1)} const prims=new Set(); home.forEach(n=>(n.cinematicPrimitives||[]).forEach(p=>prims.add(p.name))); if(prims.size<5){console.error('distinct primitives='+prims.size+' set='+JSON.stringify([...prims]));process.exit(1)} console.log('home nodes='+home.length+' distinct primitives='+prims.size+' '+JSON.stringify([...prims]));"
